Does anyone know anything about Marymount Manhattan or St Francis?
Hi!    I don't know if this is the right place to ask so please direct me elsewhere if it isn't.   So I'm already familiar with New York City- I live in North NJ and go basically biweekly. I have friends there and everything so it's not a question of what the area the colleges are in are like, it's more of like what the experience is like, if that makes sense?  Has anyone here heard of Saint Francis? It's in Brooklyn heights, p small, liberal arts I think? I was thinking of applying there next year, but I don't know how the academics are. There's not too many reviews online and plus I wanna see what the local connotations associated with the name are.   My dream school though is Marymount Manhattan on 71st. I've toured it but I've no idea what it's like to actually live on the UES as a student. I got the idea that it's a lot of families. Of course the entire cities your campus and no one is forcing you to stay in the UES or even Manhattan when you want to hang out, but I'm curious to see what day to day like would be there. Also, again with the academics. I think they're good but what's their local reputation?  Hope this was sort of clear, I'm bad at asking questions. Also don't recommend Columbia or NYU to me as up until this year I had like a 60 average and won't get in. I have an 85 now but lmao
